Geopolitics & Diplomacy
• Russia freed U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard after a request from President Trump; no prisoner swap was required, according to U.S. statements.
• Trump’s envoy Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin as part of a renewed push to end the war in Ukraine.

• King Charles III hosted Oman’s Sultan Haitham on the UK’s first Oman state visit in 44 years.
• Uzbekistan signed the Artemis Accords, joining U.S.-led principles for civil space exploration.
Why it matters: Rapid moves on prisoner diplomacy, Ukraine support, and space cooperation underscore shifting U.S.-Russia dynamics and broader realignments in global partnerships.

Economy & Markets.title: Apple Is Limiting iPhone Duo Orders to Two Per Customer After Demand Pushes Shipping to January 2027
Economy & Markets.text: SummaryApple locks down global pre-orders for the new device with a strict two-unit cap per customerThe tech giant implements the checkout restriction after an extraordinary initial surge pushed shipping dates to 2027Alternative retailers currently offer faster turnaround times for different storage configurationsApple officially throttles the hype. In response to overwhelming global demand, the tech giant implemented a strict limit of two iPhone Duo pre-orders per customer across its worldwide online storefronts. The sweeping restriction applies uniformly regardless of the chosen device configuration, capping how many units buyers can secure directly from the source. Attempting to load more than two of the devices into an Apple Store digital cart immediately triggers an automated roadblock. The online checkout notification shuts down bulk buyers, stating: "A maximum of 2 iPhone Duo can be purchased per customer. Please adjust the total quantity of iPhone Duo in your order before checking out."The global lockdown spans well beyond the United States, actively restricting buyers in major international markets including Japan, Spain and the United Kingdom. When Apple initially started taking pre-orders for the iPhone Duo on October 16, the digital gates were wide open. Early adopters operating within Reddit’s dedicated iPhone Duo community reported successfully placing orders for more than two units right as the pre-order window first went live. Now, the landscape has entirely shifted, though it remains notably unclear exactly how Apple prevents dedicated scalpers from circumventing the new two-device limit by simply creating multiple fresh accounts or cycling through different credit cards.Apple previously stated that consumer demand for the iPhone Duo was "nothing short of extraordinary," an assessment verified when the company was forced to push back estimated shipping dates for the device to 2027 shortly after the pre-order period officially began. This aggressive purchase restriction acts as a direct countermeasure to that unprecedented initial surge, proving that the staggering early momentum fundamentally overwhelmed standard Apple Store fulfillment queues and forced a complete recalibration of how the drop is handled.Buyers attempting to secure the device directly from the brand today must exercise significant patience. Apple’s online stores currently display a distant shipping estimate of January 22 for any new iPhone Duo orders. There is a slight glimmer of hope for early buyers, as some customers reported that their initially delayed shipping estimates unexpectedly bumped up to earlier delivery slots. Meanwhile, standard third-party retail channels offer slightly more optimistic timelines. Best Buy currently lists a November 10 pick-up and shipping date for the 512GB iPhone Duo, while buyers looking for the 256GB iPhone Duo currently see a listed pick-up and shipping date of December 14 at the retailer.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Climate & Environment.title: Burnham faces Badenoch at PMQs after Jackdaw gasfield approved – UK politics live
Climate & Environment.text:
The Jackdaw field will start supplying gas to homes and businesses from the end of the month, the government saidHere is an explainer by Jill Ambrose about the Jackdaw decision.But environmental groups have condemned the decision. Ami McCarthy, head of politics for Greenpeace UK, said:Approving Jackdaw shows the toxic grip fossil fuel lobbyists still hold over our energy policy. Andy Burnham promised pragmatism [see 8.40am], but there is nothing pragmatic about rubber-stamping a project that won’t lower energy bills, won’t boost energy security and will create just 27 full-time jobs …True pragmatism means severing our reliance on expensive oil and gas that leaves British households broke, supercharges extreme weather, and leaves our energy security at the mercy of petrostates.Is the prime minister living in a parallel universe? One where we haven’t just endured our hottest summer on record, with droughts, wildfires and, in all likelihood, the most heat-related deaths on record? And where the UN hasn’t warned that we’re on the brink of breaching the all-important 1.5 degree warming limit?Shell will be cheering this decision but it won’t knock a penny off our energy bills, which is what’s keeping people up at night, or make a meaningful difference to our gas supply.

Art & Culture.title: Phillips Unveils the Rarest Independent Watches Hitting the Block in Hong Kong
Art & Culture.text: SummaryPhillips spotlights independent watchmaking at The Hong Kong Watch Auction: XXIII.F.P. Journe leads with rare Chronomètre à Résonance and Tourbillon Souverain examples.Voutilainen, Haldimann, Auffret and Kiu Tai Yu also feature among the November highlights.Phillips in Association with Bacs & Russo is sharpening the focus on independent watchmaking for The Hong Kong Watch Auction: XXIII, set to take place in November. Following the previously announced group of rare Patek Philippe wristwatches leading the sale, the latest highlights bring together fresh-to-market pieces from F.P. Journe, Kari Voutilainen, Beat Haldimann, Théo Auffret and Kiu Tai Yu, with rarity, provenance and collector-driven commissions running throughout the selection.At the top of the group is the F.P. Journe Chronomètre à Résonance “Parking Meter” Mark Cho Special, one of just five examples made and offered directly from the personal collection of The Armoury co-founder Mark Cho. Created in collaboration with François-Paul Journe and Pierre Halimi, the 38mm platinum watch features a navy-and-warm-toned dial personally selected by Cho and carries an estimate of $6 million - $12 million HKD ( approx. $769,000 - $1.54 million USD).F.P. Journe continues to dominate the upper end of the independent offering. A circa-2001 Tourbillon Souverain No. 069 pairs a platinum case with an exceptionally rare shiny yellow-gold dial, with only nine examples of the configuration currently documented. Part of the sought-after third series of early brass-movement Tourbillon Souverain models, it combines a tourbillon with a remontoir d’égalité and is estimated at $3.9 million - $11.6 million HKD ($500,000 - $1.49 million USD). Also appearing is a Centigraphe Souverain Anniversaire Hong Kong Boutique Edition, number 10 of 20 pieces produced in 2016, estimated between $2.4 million - $4.8 million HKD ($308,000 - $615,000 USD), alongside the first-produced example of the Octa Calendrier Ruthenium, numbered 01 of 99 and carrying an estimate in excess of $1.6 million HKD ($205,000 USD).Beyond Journe, the sale broadens into a cross-section of contemporary independent horology. A titanium Kari Voutilainen Vingt-8 with a hand-guilloché blue enamel dial - one of only two special commissions in titanium - is estimated at $1.5 million - $2.5 million HKD ($192,000 - $321,000 USD), while Beat Haldimann’s platinum H1 Flying Central Tourbillon “The PuristS Edition” Series 2 carries an estimate of $1 million - $2 million HKD ($128,000 to $256,000 USD). Théo Auffret’s Tourbillon à Paris Subscription No. 18, the first example of the model to appear at auction, and Kiu Tai Yu’s limited-edition white-gold HK 2000 further round out the lineup.The Hong Kong Watch Auction: XXIII will be held on November 21 - 22, 2026 with a public preview running from November 16 - 22 at Phillips’ WKCDA Tower location in West Kowloon; selected highlights will also tour Hong Kong, Taipei, Geneva and Singapore ahead of the sale.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Hajime Sorayama Chromes Out GEEKS RULE’s DSM Ginza-Exclusive 'Ghost in the Shell' Long-Sleeve
Entertainment.text: SummaryGEEKS RULE has reworked its popular 'The Ghost in the Shell' TV anime tee into a limited long-sleeve versionThe front shows Major Motoko Kusanagi perched on a red Fuchikoma, while the back carries an icon designed by Hajime SorayamaA one-off sleeve print makes this version a special edition that won’t be repeatedGEEKS RULE has released a limited long-sleeve edition of its collaboration T-shirt with the TV anime The Ghost in the Shell, reworking a design that drew immediate buzz when it first launched. The new version keeps the original front and back artwork and adds an exclusive sleeve graphic, turning it into a one-time special edition.The release builds on one of the most influential franchises in anime and cyberpunk. Ghost in the Shell began as Shirow Masamune’s manga, first serialized by Kodansha in 1989, and went on to shape global sci-fi through Mamoru Oshii’s 1995 film and the Stand Alone Complex TV series. The latest TV anime adaptation, directed by Mokochan, is produced by Science SARU.The front of the shirt uses the series’ key visual of Major Motoko Kusanagi seated on top of a Fuchikoma, the spider-like think tank. Rendered in bold reds and cool blues, the artwork captures the Major in her blue tactical suit and visor, with “THE GHOST IN THE SHELL” lettering underneath. The Fuchikoma itself comes straight from Masamune’s original manga and served as the predecessor to the Stand Alone Complex series’ better-known Tachikoma.The back features an icon designed by Hajime Sorayama, set as glowing chrome lettering inside a triangle outline. Sorayama is best known for his hyperreal chrome robot illustrations, which have appeared on everything from album art to luxury fashion collaborations. For this edition, “DOVER STREET MARKET GINZA” is printed in bold white type down one sleeve, the detail that separates it from the earlier short-sleeve T-shirt. The shirt is silkscreen-printed on a black body and comes in sizes M through XXL.The GEEKS RULE x The Ghost in the Shell long-sleeve T-shirt drops October 24 from 11 a.m. only at Dover Street Market Ginza’s Open House event, a recurring gathering of designers and artists from Japan and abroad. Director Mokochan will also host a signing on October 23 from 6 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. at Rose Bakery on the store’s seventh floor. Entry requires advance registration through Peatix and closes once spots are filled. Attendees can buy the shirt early on the sixth floor, and each person may have one item signed, either the T-shirt or an illustration sheet handed out at the event.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: ‘MURCIÉLAGO’ Anime Reveals Its Main Cast in New Teaser Trailer
Entertainment.text: SummaryMURCIÉLAGO reveals its central cast in a new teaser trailer.Hitomi Ueda voices Kuroko Koumori, alongside Minori Suzuki and Sumire Uesaka.The crime anime premieres in January 2027.MURCIÉLAGO has unveiled a new teaser trailer that introduces the voices behind its central trio ahead of the TV anime’s January 2027 premiere.The footage puts former death-row inmate Kuroko Koumori at the center, opening on a mugshot-like image of the scarred protagonist before showing flashes of her wielding an oversized handgun with an almost gleeful disregard for the violence around her. Hitomi Ueda will voice Kuroko, while Minori Suzuki joins as her partner and minder Hinako Tozakura, whose deceptively cheerful demeanor contrasts with her extraordinary driving skills. Sumire Uesaka rounds out the newly announced leads as Chiyo Yanaoka, Kuroko’s girlfriend and the daughter of a yakuza boss. The preview debuts all three performances while leaning into the manga’s collision of black comedy, gunplay and heightened violence, offering the clearest sense yet of how the adaptation plans to translate its deliberately unhinged tone to animation.Adapted from Kana Yoshimura’s manga, which has run in Square Enix’s Young Gangan since 2013, MURCIÉLAGO follows Kuroko after she is spared execution and instead recruited as a state-sanctioned killer tasked with eliminating criminals whose brutality demands equally extreme measures.The latest teaser follows the project’s earlier “super teaser” and January release-window announcement, further establishing the dangerous buddy dynamic between Kuroko and Hinako that drives the series. MURCIÉLAGO begins airing in Japan in January 2027, with HIDIVE set to stream the series in territories including the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Australia and New Zealand./／　TVアニメ『ムルシエラゴ』　ティザービジュアル解禁㊗️\＼#MURCIÉLAGO#ムルシエラゴ https://t.co/VgsGtM7o7o— TVアニメ『ムルシエラゴ』公式 (@murcielago_anm) October 20, 2026Read more at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Kiko Kostadinov and ASICS Refresh the US8-S GEL-SJ33 in Two New Colorways
Entertainment.text: Name: Kiko Kostadinov x ASICS US8-S GEL-SJ33Colorway: Moonrock/Tatami Green, Deep Plum/Fresh GrassSKU: 1203B116.250, 1203B116.500MSRP: $170 USDRelease Date: October 23Where to Buy: ASICSKiko Kostadinov and ASICS return to the US8-S GEL-SJ33 with two new colorways this season, following the “Black Coffee” and “Roasted Coffee” editions released earlier this summer. Entertainment.title: PEACEMINUSONE x WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto Put Pin-Ups and Daisies on Leather
Entertainment.text: SummaryPEACEMINUSONE and WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto have joined forces on a capsule built around vintage-style pin-up illustrations and oversized daisiesThe lineup includes black and brown leather jackets, a long black coat with a printed lining and a pink leather toteEach piece pairs WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto branding with a “10th Anniversary” mark, its “Anniversary” lettering struck throughG-DRAGON’s PEACEMINUSONE and WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto have unveiled a collaborative capsule that puts retro pin-up artwork and oversized daisy motifs across leather outerwear and accessories. Shot against a dark, moody backdrop, the lookbook shows a tight edit of jackets, a coat and a tote, each carrying large-scale back or front graphics.Leather jackets anchor the collection, offered in glossy black and a deep brown. Both feature a spread collar, a full-length zip and a boxy cut, with a small PEACEMINUSONE wordmark printed on the chest. The black version adds flap pockets at the waist and ribbed trim at the hem and cuffs. Turned around, each jacket reveals a different illustration: the black style shows a kneeling pin-up in a white swimsuit beside a giant daisy, set off by “10th Anniversary” type in pale blue, while the brown version places a brunette-toned figure in a black swimsuit and heels perched atop a daisy, finished with gold lettering.A long black coat brings a quieter silhouette, cut double-breasted with broad lapels and a relaxed, floor-skimming length. Its real statement is on the inside, where a white lining is printed with the pin-up and daisy artwork and the black “10th Anniversary” mark, while the sleeves are lined in a striped fabric. The lookbook styles the coat inside out to put that lining on full display.The capsule closes with an oversized tote in bubblegum pink leather. Long shoulder straps and a slouchy body give it an everyday shape, while the front carries a pin-up with roses in her hair beside a daisy, along with the “10th Anniversary” graphic in light blue and the WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto logo near the base.The PEACEMINUSONE x WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto capsule drops October 23 via PEACEMINUSONE Online, followed by a release through WILDSIDE on October 30.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Nicolas Cage Transforms Into a Con Man for 'Best Pancakes in the County' Trailer
Entertainment.text: SummaryIFC Films has unveiled the first official trailer for Ken Sanzel’s crime thriller Best Pancakes in the CountyNicolas Cage stars as a con man named The S.O.B. who gets trapped in a diner standoff involving rogue federal agentsThe feature is scheduled to debut in select theaters and across digital platforms on November 20IFC Films has debuted the official trailer for Best Pancakes in the County, an upcoming crime thriller written and directed by Ken Sanzel. The film stars an unrecognizable Nicolas Cage leading an ensemble cast through a high-stakes hostage situation.Starring Cage as a fast-talking con man named The S.O.B., the narrative centers on an unimpressive small-town diner that unexpectedly turns into the location for a violent standoff involving rogue federal agents. In the trailer, Cage’s character attempts to broker a sensitive discovery, stating, “Nine years ago, there was a hard drive with dirt on the CIA,” before adding, “I hope the hard drive can be monetized.” Later in the clip, he deadpans, “Why do you think I insisted on meeting here? For the pancakes?”Alongside Cage, the ensemble cast features Justin Long, Shelley Hennig, Lauren German, Ravi Patel, Brandon Mychal Smith, Kelly Greyson, Jaylen Moore, and Michael Sirow. Produced by Eduard Osipov, Raja Collins, Eric Brenner, Niko Fomenko, Gary Preisler, and R. Wesley Sierk III, the project follows Cage’s appearances in Longlegs, The Carpenter’s Son, and Spider-Noir, ahead of his upcoming role in David O. Russell's Madden.Best Pancakes in the County will be released in select theaters and on digital platforms on November 20, 2026, via IFC Films.Read more at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: S'YTE and TAION Reunite for Their Fourth Collaborative Collection
Entertainment.text: SummaryS'YTE and TAION reunite for their fourth collaboration, combining experimental tailoring with technical down insulation.Highlights include embroidered reversible bombers, utility vests and convertible quilted pants.Launching October 22 via THE SHOP YOHJI YAMAMOTO.Yohji Yamamoto's S'YTE and TAION are reuniting for the fourth installment of their ongoing collaboration, bringing together experimental silhouettes and technical insulation for Fall/Winter 2026. Rooted in S'YTE's anti-mode philosophy, the latest collection explores the intersection of military-inspired utility and the unconventional design language associated with Yohji Yamamoto.Continuing the approach established in previous releases, the range incorporates TAION's 800-fill-power down insulation, offering lightweight warmth while minimizing the excessive bulk typically associated with padded outerwear. Every piece features either reversible construction or a two-way design, emphasizing versatility without compromising the collection's distinctive proportions and understated aesthetic.Leading the lineup is the Embroidery Reversible Bomber Jacket, crafted from lustrous black velveteen and decorated with intricate embroidery depicting birds, swallowtail butterflies and colorful flowers. Its reverse features a more restrained finish, while the back displays bold Japanese lettering and a crow perched on a branch, introducing a darker contrast to the decorative motifs.Elsewhere, the Reversible Embroidered Long Bomber Jacket reinterprets the classic MA-1 through an exaggerated, elongated silhouette, accented by vibrant pink dahlia embroidery and contrasting ribbed trims. The Reversible Utility Pouch Down Vest incorporates military-style quilting and a detachable chest pouch that doubles as a standalone shoulder bag.Completing the collection are a generously proportioned hooded down jacket featuring four oversized patch pockets and diamond-quilted convertible pants, which can be transformed into shorts through zippers positioned around the knees. Together, the five designs balance practical adaptability with S'YTE's signature oversized shapes and dramatic detailing.The S'YTE x TAION Collaboration Collection Vol. 4 is scheduled to launch on October 22, 2026, through THE SHOP YOHJI YAMAMOTO's official online store at 12 p.m. JST and select Yohji Yamamoto retail locations across Japan.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
